title: Grooming day, reversed: your dog takes the clippers and trims the groomer
summary: Make a short, silly clip from one photo of your dog: it sits up on the grooming table, pats the groomer, and gives them a gentle trim.
why: A trend template page lists a TikTok posted November 8, 2026 of a dog on a grooming table that rises toward the groomer mid-haircut, lifts a paw beside them and ends on a close view of clippers by the person's head. The page says it had 1.6 million views and 79,000 likes on November 12.
steps: Pick a clear photo of your dog, ideally standing or sitting, with its whole face in view.
Paste the main prompt into an image-to-video tool. Ask for about 10 to 12 seconds, vertical.
Add a caption at the top, like "She said it was my turn."
Add a playful sound that's free to use in your app, and label the post as made with AI.

prompts.label: Main prompt: the role swap
prompts.text: Animate the dog in this photo. Vertical video, about 11 seconds, in a bright, tidy grooming salon. The dog stands on a grooming table while a groomer in a smock trims its fur with quiet clippers. Halfway through, the dog sits up tall, gently puts one paw on the groomer's shoulder and looks at them like it has a plan. Quick cut: the groomer now sits on a stool, calm and laughing, while the dog holds the clippers in its paw and carefully trims a tiny bit of their hair. End on a close-up of the dog looking very proud. Gentle and playful, no one is hurt or scared. Keep the dog's face, coat and markings the same as the photo. No text, no logos.

prompts.label: Variation: the fluffy before-and-after
prompts.text: Animate the dog in this photo. Vertical video, about 10 seconds, at a grooming salon. Start with the dog looking extra fluffy and a bit messy on the grooming table. A soft puff of fur, a quick cut, and the dog is now neatly trimmed with a small bow on its collar. It turns to the camera, does a little proud head tilt, then lifts a paw like it's waving. Bright, clean light. Keep the dog looking like the photo. No text, no logos.

prompts.label: Variation: small business
prompts.text: Animate this photo of a dog from our grooming salon [upload, with the owner's OK]. Vertical video, about 10 seconds. The dog sits on our grooming table in a bright, clean room. It looks at our groomer, then gently taps the clippers with its paw as if it's checking our work. Cut to the dog, neatly groomed, giving a happy head tilt to the camera. Friendly, calm mood, no one is hurt or scared. Keep the dog true to the photo. No logos or brand names.

tips: Say the mood out loud in the prompt: calm, playful, no one hurt. It keeps the clip gentle.
Short clips work best. Faces and paws drift more after about 12 seconds.
If the clippers look odd in a paw, try a paw resting on the clippers instead of holding them.
Groomers and other pet businesses: only post a client's pet with the owner's OK.
